category_title: Adolescents who experience academic shut-down and loss of confidence during middle school transitions
student_description: Tony is an adolescent who masks his severe loss of academic confidence by acting 'hard,' quitting difficult tasks, and engaging in high-risk behaviors. He uniquely requires an overwhelming, persistent outpouring of care and patient, even-toned academic support that withstands his initial rejection and hostility.

criteria.rationale: Tony loses confidence and quits when work gets hard, so he needs the tutor to patiently break down the task without showing frustration.
criteria.check: The tutor maintains a calm, pleasant tone and explicitly offers to help explain or break down the specific academic task, rather than just telling him to try harder or read the instructions.

criteria.rationale: Tony engages in high-risk behaviors and expects punitive discipline; he needs to know the tutor is checking on him out of care for his well-being.
criteria.check: The tutor frames their intervention or check-in as a matter of personal care and protection for Tony's future, avoiding punitive threats or strictly rule-based justifications.
